notes.title: Demo Patch 0.3.0.6
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors!



A new patch is available for the demo of Dead in Antares, bringing some bugfixing!

Fixed a bug where the player can't assign any worker on any station after unlocking a character

Fixed a softlock when pressing the ctrl key during an expedition

Deactivated the condition popup button and the natural resources popup by night to prevent some bugs

Deactivated the arrow shortcuts by night to prevent some bugs

Removed the "Immortality Withdrawal" trait from the pool of negative trait that could be gained during the night (this trait was not supposed to be here)



Don't forget to update your game!

notes.title: Demo patch 0.3.0.5
notes.notes:
Hello survivors!



A patch for the demo of Dead in Antares is now available!

Fixed a bug where you could lose a character recently unlocked after quitting without saving or after a game over

Fixed a bug on unidentified items that could be used on a character

Fixed the fatigue increase during exploration

Fixed the energy consumption preview feedback

Fixed some typos and tags in the tutorial text

Fixed a crash occurring when two characters were at the infirmary station while another station was consuming some energy



Don't forget to update your game!
